verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a Webhook API that pushes subscribed platform events to integrators instead of requiring polling. It also describes real-time internal transfers and Fedwire settlement, which supports the event-driven, real-time part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows ledger balance reads that reflect holds or pending activity, or that webhooks fire for every transaction state change. Missing for 10: balance endpoints exposing available vs. pending/held amounts, documented transaction lifecycle states with matching webhook events, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
